note: The EU print is both the extraction source and the frozen reference: there is no separate design master for these screens. The EN block's App screens are the same English screens the fr/es/de/it blocks print.
promotion_requirements: The operator reviews the crops against the source page renders before promotion.
Promotion admits exactly one export per crop, byte-identical to the crop (a single full-canvas placement).
The promoted exports override the shared JP-market app/add_device and app/connect_result only for JE-1000F/EU.
